title: Add synthetic anchor health-check CI adapter
author: Sana Iqbal
release_notes: Add a lightweight synthetic-anchor health-check CI adapter: runs anchor-based probes against prompt-sets, emits health metrics, and can fail CI on configurable degradation thresholds. Includes unit tests and docs.
description:
Motivation: We frequently see subtle regressions that only manifest for specific anchor prompts (tokenization edge-cases, unexpected truncated responses, or slow KV-cache warmups) and those regressions are noisy to catch with bulk evals. This PR adds a lightweight CI adapter that runs a small set of synthetic anchor probes (deterministic prompts that exercise corner behaviors) as part of eval CI to detect early regressions in 'anchor health' before they propagate to downstream SLO checks.

High-level design: The adapter executes a small, configurable anchor suite (yaml-defined prompt anchors) against the PR model snapshot and compares a few signal families to a baseline: correctness fingerprint (stable token-prefix match), latency percentile (p50/p95), structure integrity (JSON/schema conformance where applicable), and hallucination heuristics (surface-level classifier score). Each anchor emits metrics prefixed with ci.synthetic_anchor.{anchor_name}.{signal}. The adapter supports two modes: "smoke" (non-blocking, annotates CI) and "gate" (blocking, fails CI when thresholds are exceeded). Baselines are bootstrapped from historical runs stored in the eval DB; if not present the adapter runs a short baseline collection pass against the target main model and stores initial anchors as the baseline.

Implementation notes: Implemented a new adapter module src/hooks/synthetic_anchor_health_adapter.py with a small runner class SyntheticAnchorHealthAdapter. The adapter integrates with the existing eval-runner lifecycle and exposes a schema-driven config located under examples/prompt_sets/synthetic_anchor.yml. The CI workflow (ci/workflows/eval-ci.yaml) is extended with an eval step that invokes the adapter in smoke or gate mode depending on PR labels (label: eval/anchor-gate toggles gate mode).

Metrics & tracing: Emits metrics: ci.synthetic_anchor.{anchor}.{ok|latency_ms|hallucination_score|schema_errors}. Traces are created with span tag ci.synthetic_anchor and include anchor_name and model_version. Dashboard and alert suggestions are documented in docs/ci-hooks/synthetic_anchor_health.md.

Testing: Added unit tests (tests/test_synthetic_anchor_health.py) that validate baseline bootstrapping, threshold evaluation, and the gating decision logic. A small fixture simulates a model stub with controlled latencies and responses. CI showed a lint warning that was fixed in the follow-up commit.

Operational considerations: The adapter is intentionally lightweight (default 6 anchors, each single-shot) to keep CI runtime small (<60s extra). Configurable parameters: anchors (list), retries, latency percentiles to sample, failure budget per-anchor. The adapter writes its outputs to the eval artifacts bucket for later inspection.

Checklist:
- [x] adapter implementation
- [x] unit tests
- [x] CI workflow integration
- [x] docs and example prompt set
- [x] review feedback addressed

See commits below for more detail.

review_comments: Avery Chen (2025-02-11): Nice concise adapter. Two requests: (1) make baseline bootstrap idempotent for concurrent CI runs (race-y writes to eval DB), (2) make the default anchors smaller so we don't regress CI run-time over time.

Author (Sana Iqbal) (2025-02-11): Addressed both. Added optimistic compare-and-write when creating baseline rows and reduced default anchors to 6. See commit b2d4e6f and updated docs to describe concurrency behavior.

Diego Martinez (2025-02-12): Can we add an explicit histogram bucket for latency_ms so dashboards can compute p95 without re-ingesting values? Also flagged an edge-case where schema_errors counter could blow up when freeform text anchors are used.
Author (2025-02-12): Added latency_ms histogram metric and capped schema_error labels (now aggregated as a single counter per anchor). Tests updated to cover the aggregation behavior.
Priya Kapoor (2025-02-13): Approve after verifying tests and docs. Left a minor docs nits request (clarify gating label semantics).

notes: Observability: metrics prefixed ci.synthetic_anchor.*, traces include span tag ci.synthetic_anchor; artifacts written to gs://eval-artifacts/synthetic-anchor/<run_id>/. CI gating controlled via label 'eval/anchor-gate'. Baseline bootstrap uses optimistic write with tombstone guard to avoid races.
additional_context: This adapter is intentionally orthogonal to full eval-backfills and focused on catching quick regressions that are high signal for prompt anchors used widely in production. Future work: add periodic scheduled runs to maintain baselines and a small web UI tile in the eval console for historical anchor health trends.
